post.text: BREAKING🚨: This is Mariano Barbacid, the scientist who may have discovered the cure for pancreatic cancer. https://t.co/TmBmFm1RwV

description.description: A medium shot of a man sitting in an office chair against a plain white background. He is wearing a dark blue suit jacket, a light blue dress shirt, and a blue and yellow diagonal striped tie. He has a prominent port-wine stain birthmark on the left side of his face. His hands are clasped in front of him, and he is looking slightly off-camera with a mild smile.

A fluorescence microscopy image showing a cluster of cells in a spherical arrangement, commonly known as a spheroid or organoid. The cell nuclei are stained blue, likely with DAPI or Hoechst, showing internal nuclear structures. The cell membranes or cell-cell junctions are traced in bright red, highlighting the boundary of each individual cell within the larger colony against a solid black background.
